summary:
Wave 9 follow-up verification against live preview. BLOCKER (signup 201 through ingress) is FIXED and verified both via REST (/api/v1/auth/signup → 201 for a fresh @example.com) and via the UI (/login → show-signup-btn → signup-success). Fresh login lands on ISSO persona with an 'Acting as ISSO' toast confirmed in acting-as-toast. Switching to AO works and header shows 'Col. Taylor (AO persona)'. Terminology on Evidence Sources is correct (cards: 'Mapped findings'/'Unmapped findings'; ingest table columns: 'MAPPED RESULTS'/'UNMAPPED RESULTS'). Control IDs use the AC-2(3) parenthesis form on POA&M (no 'AC-2.3' tokens detected). eMASS last-sync value in /emass/status (2026-10-13T23:40:26.482240Z) equals newest succeeded completed_at from /systems/{LTP}/emass runs — correct. Onboarding checklist is present with granular testids (onboarding-upload_scan / create_poam / switch_issm / approve_closure / view_leadership) and 'Switch to the ISSM persona' is already crossed out on the demo tenant. No tile showed a 0/empty before data loaded on POA&M, Mapping Review, or Audit log. Rate limit: 5 sign-ups/hour per IP is enforced (hit it during tests, which actually proves the limiter now works correctly — before the fix it was 429 for everyone).

ONE BLOCKER DISCOVERED: the 'Out of scope / N/A (needs approval)' mapping-review action is BROKEN. POST /api/v1/mapping-review/rule-action with action='out_of_scope' + justification + finding_ids returns HTTP 409 {"detail":"No active decision rule for finding_out_of_scope"}. GET /api/v1/decision-rules returns 10 rules but NONE for request_type='finding_out_of_scope' (only assessment_result, authorization_decision, authorization_package_review, control_implementation_review, deadline_extension, emass_submission, false_positive, poam_closure, risk_acceptance, waiver_extension). The ISSM-approval leg of acceptance criterion #3 cannot execute without this seed. Verified against demo tenant (sandbox) — a brand-new signup inherits the same seeded rule set so the problem is systemic, not demo-sandbox-specific.

critical.issue: Returns 409 'No active decision rule for finding_out_of_scope' because the seed/migration never created a DecisionRule row for request_type='finding_out_of_scope'. phase4.py creates the ApprovalRequest via wf.create_request(..., request_type='finding_out_of_scope') which looks up the active rule and blows up. Fix: add a seeded DecisionRule with request_type='finding_out_of_scope', active=true, assigned_role='issm' (or auto-create it on first use). Blocks acceptance criterion #3.

minor.issue: All 404. The per-system endpoint /api/v1/systems/{id}/emass returns runs. The UI banner on /emass reads 'Last sync 2026-10-13 23:40:26Z' which matches /emass/status, but there is no tenant-wide sync-history REST endpoint. Minor API-surface inconsistency; not a user-visible failure.

ui_bugs.issue: No element with data-testid='emass-last-sync'. The last-sync value is baked into the banner text ('Last sync 2026-10-13 23:40:26Z') on data-testid='emass-mode-banner'. The acceptance criterion is still met (value is visible and matches), but a dedicated testid would make assertions robust.
Logout button testid is 'header-logout-btn' but the review description and earlier iterations referred to 'logout-btn'. Low priority naming consistency note.

integration_issues.flow: Mapping Review — Out of scope action
integration_issues.issue: UI button 'Out of scope / N/A (needs approval)' triggers POST /api/v1/mapping-review/rule-action which 409s due to missing DecisionRule seed. The pending-disposition chip (pending-disposition-*) therefore never renders and the rule never leaves the unmapped list. End-to-end flow (ISSO submits → ISSM approves in Reviews → removed from unmapped) cannot complete.

issues: Benign CSP console errors from Cloudflare beacon.min.js and blob-worker. Unchanged from prior iterations; platform-injected, not application code.

action_items: CRITICAL: Seed a DecisionRule for request_type='finding_out_of_scope' (active=true, assigned_role='issm') in sandbox provisioning / migrations so the Mapping-Review out-of-scope flow produces a pending ApprovalRequest instead of 409. Alternatively, make wf.create_request auto-create a default rule for this request_type.
(LOW) Add data-testid='emass-last-sync' to the last-sync value in the banner on /emass so UI tests can assert it directly.
(LOW) Decide whether the logout button testid should be 'logout-btn' or 'header-logout-btn' and update docs/tests to match.
critical_code_review_comments: BLOCKER-fix for signup limiter looks correct: /api/v1/auth/signup now returns 201 for a fresh @example.com account coming through the public ingress — previously the limiter keyed on the ingress peer IP so every tenant hit the 5/hour window immediately. The fix in security/web.py:client_ip (walking X-Forwarded-For when the immediate peer is in TRUSTED_PROXIES) is now producing per-real-client counts; I hit the 5/hour limit myself only AFTER making 5 signups from the same test IP, which confirms the limiter is correctly scoped.

SoD contract still clean: the ISSO persona cannot approve its own request; act-as to ISSM returns a fresh token pair bound to the persona and decisions succeed. Persona reset on fresh login works: switching to AO then logging in again lands back on ISSO with an acting-as-toast of 'Acting as ISSO'.

Evidence Sources UX terminology is now consistent with the spec in both places (cards='Mapped findings'/'Unmapped findings', ingest table columns='MAPPED RESULTS'/'UNMAPPED RESULTS'). Clear separation between the raw ingest counts and the canonical finding counts.
eMASS /emass/status.last_sync_at now equals the newest succeeded /systems/{sid}/emass run completed_at (2026-10-13T23:40:26.482240Z on LTP). Good.
Control-ID formatting is consistent across POA&M table/detail (no 'AC-2.3' leakage; AC-17(2) renders correctly).

Onboarding checklist is driven by real events via sandbox.onboarding_events — testids are granular (onboarding-upload_scan, onboarding-create_poam, onboarding-switch_issm, onboarding-approve_closure, onboarding-view_leadership). 'Switch to the ISSM persona' is already ticked on the demo tenant because an act-as to issm occurred.

BLOCKER (real): the OOS flow depends on a DecisionRule row that is not seeded. phase4.py:148 (/mapping-review/rule-action, action='out_of_scope') calls wf.create_request(request_type='finding_out_of_scope') but no corresponding DecisionRule exists in the sandbox DB — 10 rules present, none for finding_out_of_scope. This fails hard with 409 and blocks the Reviews-flow acceptance criterion end-to-end.

seed_data_creation: A few throwaway signups on preview via /auth/signup with Sandbox!Pass-2026x. One attempted OOS mapping-review action on the demo sandbox did NOT mutate state (409 before any insert). No PO&M closure reviews were created in this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: LTP id on demo sandbox at this run = e5078505-5384-4963-a3eb-1c3608d2c3e9 (changes nightly). Signup limit is now 5/hour per client IP — if you share the egress IP with a previous run you may hit 429 on signup; use a cooldown or the demo account. OOS mapping-review endpoint shape: POST /api/v1/mapping-review/rule-action with body {system_id, action:'out_of_scope', rule_id, finding_ids:[...], justification}. Currently 409s due to missing DecisionRule for request_type='finding_out_of_scope'. The eMASS runs endpoint is per-system: GET /api/v1/systems/{sid}/emass (returns {status, changes, runs}); there is NO tenant-wide /emass/sync-history. The UI banner on /emass shows the last-sync string via data-testid='emass-mode-banner' (no dedicated 'emass-last-sync' testid). Logout button testid is 'header-logout-btn'.
rca of the issue: Mapping-Review 'Out of scope / N/A (needs approval)' is blocked by a missing seed row. phase4.py creates an ApprovalRequest via wf.create_request(request_type='finding_out_of_scope') which looks up an active DecisionRule for that request_type to decide assigned_role, approval SLA, etc. The sandbox provisioner seeds decision rules for 10 request_types (poam_closure, risk_acceptance, false_positive, authorization_decision, etc.) but omits 'finding_out_of_scope'. Fix: add the seed in whichever module seeds decision rules on sandbox provisioning (likely alongside the other 10 seeds). Reproduction: login as demo, POST /mapping-review/rule-action {system_id, action:'out_of_scope', rule_id:<any unmapped>, finding_ids:[...], justification:'x'} → 409 'No active decision rule for finding_out_of_scope'. The 'Acting as ISSO' toast + persona reset on relogin + signup-201 BLOCKER fix are all verified green.
